copilot.title: Find_out Copilot
copilot.subtitle: One agent that connects to every module, reads real evidence, and reports what works, what is broken, and what to do next.
copilot.goalPlaceholder: Example: audit every module, list what is broken, and tell me exactly how to fix it
copilot.disclaimer: The agent only reasons over stored evidence and live sources. Unavailable sources are reported as unverified, never as safe.
copilot.runningTitle: The agent is working through your modules
copilot.runningDetail: It is calling real tools (diagnostics, findings, investigations) and will return a trace of every step.
copilot.noAuditDetail: Run the audit to let the agent connect to every module and show exactly which ones are failing.

lookalike.title: Look-alike names & logo similarity
lookalike.subtitle: Generate likely imitation domains, compare a suspect domain against your brand, and measure logo similarity.
lookalike.note: These are hypotheses generated from your brand name. Confirm registration and ownership before acting on any domain.
lookalike.domainRequired: Both a brand name and a suspect domain are required.
lookalike.logoRequired: Provide both images — upload them or use HTTPS URLs.
lookalike.notLookalike: does not match the look-alike rules for
lookalike.logoMatch: The icons are highly similar — treat this as supporting evidence, not proof.
lookalike.logoNoMatch: Similarity is below the impersonation threshold.
lookalike.logoNote: Perceptual comparison is supporting evidence, not proof of impersonation.

chat.title: Find_out Copilot
chat.subtitle: Ask the AI agent about your brands, findings and modules
chat.placeholder: Ask about risk, evidence or a broken module…
chat.empty: Ask a question and the agent answers from live platform data. It names the modules that are not working instead of guessing.

detections.title: Detection records
detections.subtitle: Every detection carries Source, Suspected asset, Evidence, Similarity/Risk score and Status. Confirm or dismiss with a recorded audit trail.
detections.queueHint: Highest-risk records that still need an analyst decision.
detections.empty: No detection records yet. Run a monitoring scan to create them.
detections.selectHint: Select a record to review its evidence and record a decision.
detections.notePlaceholder: Reason for this decision (stored in the audit history)
detections.officialNote: This candidate matches a verified official asset. It is excluded from detection and can never be confirmed as impersonation.
